{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Drop QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
df_clean = df[df['revenue'] != '999999.99'].copy()

# Remove refunded orders (status == 'refunded') because they are not conversions
# Conversion is defined as 'completed' checkout
converted_df = df_clean[df_clean['status'] == 'completed'].copy()

# Compute overall conversion rate by channel
channel_summary = converted_df.groupby('channel')['converted'].agg(['count', 'sum'])
channel_summary['conversion_rate'] = channel_summary['sum'] / channel_summary['count']

# Extract conversion rates for email and paid_search
email_rate = channel_summary.loc['email', 'conversion_rate']
paid_search_rate = channel_summary.loc['paid_search', 'conversion_rate']

# Compute difference
difference = email_rate - paid_search_rate

# Print the values explicitly
print("email_rate:", email_rate)
print("paid_search_rate:", paid_search_rate)
print("difference:", difference)"}
